picks.what: View from the Fuensanta sanctuary, photograph

gaps: P0–P2: no candidates; P5: none (the 1930–31 Mittelholzer aerials, #6 and #7, show Águilas, a different town)
notes: #1 (Cartagena), #3 (Cantavieja, Aragon), #6/#7 (Águilas) and #10 (La Unión) are other places in or near the region, not the city. P4 alternative: #5, a Rijksmuseum albumen print (about 1885–92) of the town across the Segura with the cathedral tower small at left; a general view but black and white, with the city a thin strip. #9 is hazy and modest in size (2016 px); #11 (2007) is a broader view of the city in the valley but without recognizable landmarks.
